name: Awesome Copilot Agents
headline: Copilot agent skills for GitHub AI
short_description: Enhance GitHub Copilot AI with curated instructions, prompts, and agent skills. Ideal for developers and operations teams to streamline workflows and improve code generation. Integrates with VSCode Copilot Chat and Claude agents.
author: Code-and-Sorts

sections.overview:
awesome-copilot-agents is a curated directory of GitHub Copilot customizations including instructions, prompts, agent skills, and MCPs organized by programming language, framework, and workflow. It provides repository-specific context such as coding standards, frameworks, and project rules to improve Copilot's code suggestions. The collection includes boilerplate templates for languages like Python, JavaScript, Go, Rust, and Java, plus specialized instructions for frameworks like Express, Azure Functions, and Terraform. It helps developers streamline workflows by guiding Copilot with contextual details about their project's tech stack, coding style, and team practices.
Create tailored Copilot instructions for specific programming languages and frameworks.
Generate structured prompts for AI-assisted development tasks like PRD creation and task execution.
Utilize boilerplate templates to standardize coding practices across projects.
Implement custom agents to enhance Copilot's contextual understanding of your codebase.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Code-and-Sorts/awesome-copilot-agents`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
